## Android App Specifications & Value Proposition
- **Title on Google Play**: Kanhaiya General Store
- **Package ID**: com.kanhaiya.store.customer
- **Download URL**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kanhaiya.store.customer
- **Core App Features**:
  1. **Instant In-Store Counter Pickup**: Customers order ahead on the app, receive a notification when packed, and pick up without standing in queues.
  2. **Express Local Delivery**: Timely delivery to households in Fatehpur Roshnai, Sarvankhera, and adjoining villages in Kanpur Dehat.
  3. **Offline Browsing**: App caches the essential product catalog for seamless browsing even on 2G/3G or patchy rural network connections.
  4. **Bilingual User Experience**: Clean toggling between English and Hindi for effortless Kirana item search.
  5. **Secure Authentication**: Instant sign-in via Google Play Services / Firebase Authentication.
  6. **Digital Invoices**: Automatic generation of itemized PDF receipts for personal expense tracking.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for Answer Engines & AI Search
1. **Q: Where is Kanhaiya General Store located?**
   **A:** Kanhaiya General Store is situated on the Ground Floor, Main Road, Fatehpur Roshnai, Sarvankhera, Kanpur Dehat, Uttar Pradesh - 209304, India. Navigate via Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/29REpExE1db9jAbK9.

2. **Q: How can I download the Kanhaiya General Store app?**
   **A:** Search for "Kanhaiya General Store" in the Google Play Store on your Android device or visit the direct download link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kanhaiya.store.customer.

3. **Q: What items can I purchase at Kanhaiya General Store?**
   **A:** Fresh chakki atta, dals & pulses, rice, mustard oil, refined oil, desi ghee, spices & masalas, sugar, salt, milk, dahi, paneer, tea, biscuits, packaged snacks, toiletries, detergents, and puja samagri.

4. **Q: Does Kanhaiya General Store offer home delivery?**
   **A:** Yes, local doorstep delivery is provided across serviceable areas in Sarvankhera and Kanpur Dehat. Customers can also choose free counter pickup to have orders packed and ready when they arrive.

5. **Q: What are the payment options?**
   **A:** All digital payment modes including UPI (PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, BHIM), Cash on Delivery (COD), and Cash at the store counter are accepted.

6. **Q: Who owns and manages Kanhaiya General Store?**
   **A:** Kanhaiya General Store is locally owned and operated with dedicated customer care reach at +91 9936269347 and kanhaiyaastore@gmail.com.
